root_cause.text: A change in `mm/migrate` made `do_swap_page()` use `folio_trylock()` on device-private folios and spin/retry on failure, which can livelock because the lock holder may be blocked on `lru_add_drain_all()` work that never runs while the same CPU is busy spinning.
root_cause.evidence: The patch notes that “if `hmm_range_fault()` fails a `folio_trylock()` in `do_swap_page()`, trying to acquire the lock of a device-private folio for migration, to ram, the function will spin until it succeeds,” and explains this can starve the work item needed by the lock holder in `migrate_device_unmap()->lru_add_drain_all()`; the fix changes `do_swap_page()` from `pte_unmap_unlock()` to `softleaf_entry_wait_on_locked(entry, vmf->ptl)` to wait for unlock instead of spinning.

intent_record.intent_summary: Rename the locked-wait helper to reflect the new softleaf entry terminology without changing behavior.
intent_record.what: The function declaration `migration_entry_wait_on_locked(softleaf_t entry, spinlock_t *ptl)` was renamed to `softleaf_entry_wait_on_locked(softleaf_t entry, spinlock_t *ptl)`. The parameter list and release annotation remain unchanged.
intent_record.how: This changes only the symbol name used at the declaration level, so it affects how the function is identified and referenced by callers or matching definitions, but not its runtime behavior or locking semantics.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a placeholder wait helper that warns on use but still releases the lock to preserve correct lock handling.
intent_record.what: A new static inline function `softleaf_entry_wait_on_locked(softleaf_t entry, spinlock_t *ptl)` was added, annotated with `__releases(ptl)`. The function unconditionally calls `WARN_ON_ONCE(1);` and then releases the passed spinlock via `spin_unlock(ptl);`.
intent_record.how: At runtime, any call to this helper will trigger a one-time warning and then unlock the page-table lock. This makes the operation explicitly visible as an unexpected or unsupported path while still ensuring the lock is released to avoid deadlock or lock leakage.

intent_record.intent_summary: Update the helper documentation and naming to describe waiting on both migration and device_private entries.
intent_record.what: The function/kernel-doc comment was renamed from `migration_entry_wait_on_locked` to `softleaf_entry_wait_on_locked`, and its description was expanded to mention both migration and `device_private` swap entries instead of only migration entries. The parameter documentation for `@entry` was also updated from migration-only to migration-or-device_private, and the explanatory text was adjusted accordingly, including a small wording change from referencing "the migration entry" to "@entry".
intent_record.how: This changes the documented scope of the wait helper so it is understood to apply to either migration entries or device_private entries, reflecting that callers may wait for either kind of special swap entry to be removed/unlocked. At runtime, the code behavior is implied to support waiting on both entry types, avoiding a migration-only interpretation of the helper.

intent_record.intent_summary: Rename the wait helper from migration-specific terminology to softleaf-specific terminology without changing its behavior.
intent_record.what: The function declaration `migration_entry_wait_on_locked(softleaf_t entry, spinlock_t *ptl)` was renamed to `softleaf_entry_wait_on_locked(softleaf_t entry, spinlock_t *ptl)`. The function signature, parameters, attributes, and body remain unchanged.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this change does not alter behavior; it only changes the symbol/function name used within the codebase, which affects readability and any callers that must reference the new name.

intent_record.intent_summary: Document that dropping the last reference to a device-private page requires holding ptl to remove its entry.
intent_record.what: A new explanatory comment was added to migration_entry_wait_on_locked() stating that any path dropping the last reference to a device-private page must also acquire the page table lock (ptl) to remove the device-private entry.
intent_record.how: This does not change runtime behavior; it clarifies the locking and lifetime rule that device-private pages, like migration entries, remain protected until the ptl is released when their final reference is dropped.

intent_record.intent_summary: Replace a direct PTE unlock with softleaf-specific wait handling in do_swap_page() to სწორly synchronize on locked softleaf entries.
intent_record.what: In do_swap_page(), the else-branch that previously called pte_unmap_unlock(vmf->pte, vmf->ptl) was changed to call pte_unmap(vmf->pte) followed by softleaf_entry_wait_on_locked(entry, vmf->ptl).
intent_record.how: At runtime, the page table entry is still unmapped, but the lock handling now goes through a softleaf-specific wait helper instead of directly unlocking the PTE lock. This changes the control flow to wait on a locked softleaf entry before proceeding, likely ensuring correct synchronization with softleaf state and avoiding premature unlock/unexpected races.

intent_record.intent_summary: Switch the locked wait helper to the softleaf-specific implementation for migration-style entries.
intent_record.what: The call inside `migration_entry_wait()` was changed from `migration_entry_wait_on_locked(entry, ptl);` to `softleaf_entry_wait_on_locked(entry, ptl);` while leaving the surrounding control flow unchanged.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this makes the wait path invoke the softleaf-specific locked wait helper instead of the migration-specific one for entries that pass the `softleaf_is_migration(entry)` check, altering which implementation handles the locked wait and aligning the operation with softleaf entries.

intent_record.intent_summary: Switch the huge migration wait path to call the softleaf-specific wait helper and update the corresponding comment.
intent_record.what: The comment text was updated to reference `softleaf_entry_wait_on_locked()` instead of `migration_entry_wait_on_locked()`, and the function call in `migration_entry_wait_huge()` was changed from `migration_entry_wait_on_locked(entry, ptl)` to `softleaf_entry_wait_on_locked(entry, ptl)`.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this causes the huge-page migration wait path to invoke the softleaf-specific wait helper rather than the migration-entry wait helper, aligning the executed code with the updated naming/logic and ensuring the correct synchronization behavior for that entry type.

intent_record.intent_summary: Switch the PMD migration wait path to the correct softleaf entry wait helper.
intent_record.what: In pmd_migration_entry_wait(), the call from migration_entry_wait_on_locked(softleaf_from_pmd(*pmd), ptl) was replaced with softleaf_entry_wait_on_locked(softleaf_from_pmd(*pmd), ptl).
intent_record.how: At runtime, the function now waits on the softleaf-specific wait helper instead of the migration-entry wait helper for the pmd-derived entry, which changes the synchronization path used when a migration entry is present.

intent_record.intent_summary: Use the correct softleaf wait helper for softleaf migration entries in migrate_vma_collect_huge_pmd().
intent_record.what: In migrate_vma_collect_huge_pmd(), the call made when a softleaf migration entry is encountered was changed from migration_entry_wait_on_locked(entry, ptl) to softleaf_entry_wait_on_locked(entry, ptl).
intent_record.how: At runtime, the code now waits using the softleaf-specific helper for softleaf migration entries before releasing the page table lock and returning -EAGAIN, instead of using the generic migration-entry wait helper.
